description: Domain intelligence and phishing-risk signals: domain age and expiry (RDAP/WHOIS), registrar, DNS (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), SPF, DMARC and MTA-STS, DNSSEC, TLS certificate issuer and expiry, hosting network, and the company behind the site when it can be identified. Use when: deciding whether a domain, link or email sender is legitimate, or checking a domain's mail setup.

domain.description: a public domain name such as example.com (an internationalised name is accepted); no URL, port or IP address
